mapper.select: SELECT n.news_id, n.title, n.url, n.url_hash, n.summary, n.source, n.published_at, n.created_at FROM place_news pn JOIN news n ON n.news_id = pn.news_id WHERE pn.place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY n.published_at DESC, n.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO news (title, url, url_hash, summary, source, published_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{url}, #{urlHash}, #{summary}, #{source}, #{publishedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = VALUES(title), summary = VALUES(summary), source = VALUES(source), published_at = VALUES(published_at)
INSERT IGNORE INTO place_news (place_id, news_id) VALUES (#{placeId}, #{newsId})
